reason: NONE. What I noticed first was $29.99 for 30 sachets, when I pay about $15 for a bottle of Toplux 8 forms in a flash sale that lasts me 3 months. The lab QR code on every sachet is a nice touch, but I'm not paying 6 times more per month for it.
objection: $29.99 a month is way more than the $5 a month I pay now for a multi-form magnesium, and I can't see what I'd get for the extra $25 that I would actually feel.
